# f5xc_role (Data Source)

Role Defines the role the user has in a namespace. There are two kinds of roles: * user defines roles - each tenant can define a set of their roles suiting their needs. * built-in roles - volterra defined roles. Admins are free to use them but can't amend them nor can they remove them.
